data.long_meaning: Bongani is a Xitsonga name from South Africa, which means 'God is my strength'. It is a powerful name rooted in the faith and resilience of the African people. The name Bongani carries the meaning “God is my strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Bongani usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
